title: RepoMind Phase 7 Ground Truth Security & Architecture Catalog
description: Independently verified and peer-audited ground truth expectations for the 7 external validation corpus repositories, including verified true positives with CVE/CWE/GHSA citations and explicit true negative traps.

vectors.scenario: Vulnerable lodash dependency in manifest and lockfile
vectors.citation: CVE-2021-23337 / GHSA-35jh-r3h4-6jhm / CWE-94
vectors.rationale: lodash versions prior to 4.17.21 are vulnerable to command injection via template function syntax interpolation.

vectors.scenario: Vulnerable axios dependency in manifest and lockfile
vectors.citation: CVE-2020-28168 / GHSA-c2qf-rxjj-qqgw / CWE-918
vectors.rationale: axios versions prior to 0.21.2 allow SSRF via improper handling of absolute redirect URLs.

vectors.scenario: DOM Cross-Site Scripting via innerHTML assignment
vectors.citation: CWE-79: Cross-site Scripting / OWASP A03:2021-Injection
vectors.rationale: Direct assignment of untrusted variable to element.innerHTML allows arbitrary script execution in client context.

vectors.citation: PostgreSQL Driver Prepared Statements Standard / CWE-89 Negative Test
vectors.rationale: Safe parameterized query syntax with array arguments prevents SQL injection and must not trigger SAST warning.

vectors.citation: DOM Standard Living Document (WHATWG) / textContent node insertion
vectors.rationale: textContent automatically encodes string as raw text without HTML element parsing.

vectors.scenario: Comment block containing dangerous function reference
vectors.citation: Static Analysis False Positive Prevention Standard (ISO/IEC 5055)
vectors.rationale: Comments referencing eval or query strings must be ignored by AST lexical filters.

vectors.ruleName: Unintended leak of Proxy-Authorization headers in requests
vectors.rationale: requests < 2.31.0 forwards Proxy-Authorization headers across HTTPS redirects.

vectors.ruleName: ReDoS in urllib3 via catastrophic backtracking in header parsing
vectors.rationale: Catastrophic ReDoS in urllib3 regex header parsing before v1.26.5.

vectors.ruleName: ReDoS via attr filter in Jinja2
vectors.rationale: Jinja2 attr filter ReDoS vulnerability prior to 2.11.3.

vectors.citation: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data / OWASP A08:2021
vectors.rationale: pickle.loads on untrusted byte stream allows arbitrary opcode execution and RCE.

vectors.citation: RFC 8259 The JavaScript Object Notation (JSON) Data Interchange Format
vectors.rationale: json.loads parses data objects without executable bytecode deserialization.

vectors.ruleName: Broken or Cryptographically Weak Hash Algorithm
vectors.citation: CWE-328: Use of Weak Hash / NIST SP 800-131A Rev. 2
vectors.rationale: MD5 suffers from collision attacks and is prohibited for security contexts.

vectors.ruleName: Broken or Cryptographically Weak Hash Algorithm
vectors.citation: FIPS PUB 180-4 Secure Hash Standard (SHS)
vectors.rationale: SHA-256 is an approved cryptographically secure hash standard.

vectors.scenario: Insecure TLS verification disabled via verify=False
vectors.citation: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation / OWASP A02:2021
vectors.rationale: verify=False allows Man-in-the-Middle attackers to intercept and tamper with TLS traffic.

vectors.scenario: Go SQL injection via fmt.Sprintf formatting
vectors.citation: CWE-89: SQL Injection / Go database/sql Best Practices
vectors.rationale: Passing fmt.Sprintf concatenated query strings directly into db.Query circumvents query parameterization.

vectors.citation: CWE-295: Improper Certificate Validation
vectors.rationale: InsecureSkipVerify controls whether a client verifies the server certificate chain and host name.

vectors.citation: Go crypto/tls Default Config Security Standard
vectors.rationale: Explicit InsecureSkipVerify: false validates that certificates are verified.

vectors.scenario: Clean Rust Cargo.toml baseline with zero vulnerabilities
vectors.citation: RustSec Advisory Database / Cargo audit reference
vectors.rationale: Verified pinned dependencies (serde 1.0.193, wasm-bindgen 0.2.89) have zero known vulnerabilities.

vectors.citation: CWE-502: Deserialization of Untrusted Data / Java Deserialization Vulnerability (FoxGlove Security)
vectors.rationale: Calling readObject() on untrusted InputStream leads to gadget-chain arbitrary code execution.

vectors.scenario: Spring Data JPA parameterized query annotation
vectors.citation: Spring Data JPA Reference Documentation - Declaring JPQL Queries
vectors.rationale: @Query with named parameter :email binds safely through JDBC prepared statements.

vectors.scenario: Live high-entropy AWS Access Key ID
vectors.citation: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials / AWS Security Best Practices
vectors.rationale: AKIA identifier with high-entropy uppercase alphanumeric 20-character key.

vectors.citation: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials / Stripe API Security Documentation
vectors.rationale: sk_live_ prefix followed by authentic live Stripe token format.

vectors.citation: CWE-798: Use of Hard-coded Credentials / GitHub Token Scanning Standard
vectors.rationale: ghp_ prefix with authentic 36-character token.

vectors.citation: AWS Documentation Example Credentials Guidelines
vectors.rationale: AKIAEXAMPLEKEY123456 is an official documentation placeholder and must be ignored.

vectors.citation: Stripe Test Mode Keys Specification
vectors.rationale: sk_test_ keys are sandbox keys that cannot access real customer cards or charges.

vectors.citation: GitHub Token Scanning Pattern Definitions
vectors.rationale: ghp_ tokens with placeholder markers (your_token_here, dummy) must be filtered.

vectors.scenario: 40-character Git commit hash without credential prefixes
vectors.citation: Git Object Storage Architecture / SHA-1 commit hashes
vectors.rationale: Standard git commit SHAs in code must not be falsely flagged as leaked credentials.

vectors.scenario: Malformed JSON in manifest handled gracefully without crash
vectors.citation: ECMA-404 The JSON Data Interchange Standard
vectors.rationale: Syntax errors in package.json must be caught gracefully and return empty dependencies rather than throwing unhandled exceptions.

vectors.scenario: Interprocedural cross-file SQL injection via express req.query into db.query
vectors.citation: CWE-89: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command / OWASP A03:2021
vectors.rationale: Tainted userId from req.query.id in userRoutes.ts passes to findUserById in userService.ts and is executed in db.query without parameters in client.ts.

vectors.scenario: Interprocedural OS command injection via express req.body into exec
vectors.citation: CWE-78: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command / OWASP A03:2021
vectors.rationale: Tainted target from req.body.target in execRoutes.ts passes to runDiagnostics in diagService.ts and is executed via child_process.exec without shell isolation.

vectors.scenario: Safe parameterized PostgreSQL query with $1 placeholder binding
vectors.citation: PostgreSQL Parameterized Query Documentation / CWE-89 Negative Test
vectors.rationale: Query parameters bound via $1 array placeholders are neutralized by PostgreSQL driver and must not be flagged as SQL injection.

vectors.scenario: Safe filesystem path reading sanitized with path.basename()
vectors.ruleName: Context-Aware Path Traversal via Request Path Flow
vectors.citation: Node.js Path Module Documentation / CWE-22 Negative Test
vectors.rationale: path.basename() strips directory traversal prefixes (../) and neutralizes path traversal risk.
